## What it is

MeteoAndes is a public research website created by **Christian Riveros** to communicate results on Peruvian tropical glaciers in a navigable, citable and reproducible form.

## Editorial principles

- Show measurements together with uncertainty.
- Separate consolidated, diagnostic, preliminary and pending evidence.
- Do not confuse correlation with causation.
- Publish methods, metadata and code when possible.
- Never fabricate values to fill analytical gaps.
